name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
description: Encode and decode Base64 strings instantly. Handle text, files, and images with UTF-8 support.
longDescription: Base64 Encoder/Decoder provides instant encoding and decoding of Base64 data. Paste text or upload files to encode. Decode Base64 strings back to text or download as files. Supports UTF-8 for international characters. Handles images, documents, and binary data. All processing happens locally in your browser.
pricingDetails: Completely free with no file size limits. No uploads to server.
